name: selection-snap
title: Selection Snap
description: A thin word in a loose viewfinder snaps into a design-tool selection while it goes from Thin to Black, pops its handles and counts up a size badge.
useWhen: A single word should read as something being designed: a design tool, a component library, a type or layout feature.
A weight change should carry the beat: the word grows from Thin to Black inside the frame.
The title needs a precise, UI-flavored accent (selection box, handles, a W × H readout) without building interface chrome.
avoidWhen: The word should enter with physical motion rather than change in place: use stretch-in.
A plain, quiet reveal is enough and the design-tool look would distract: use soft-blur-in.
The text is a full sentence: the selection frames one short word.
author: Remocn
